div.head: I Em 3
div.ab: Gif hwa Cristenes mannes blod ageote, ne cume he na on ðas cyninges ánsyne, ær he on dædbote ga, swa biscop him tæce ⁊ his scrift him wissige.
Gif hwa Cristenes mannes blód ageote, ne cume he na on ðæs cyninges neawiste, ær he on dædbote ga, swa him biscop tæce ⁊ his scrift him wisige.
Gyf hwa Cristenes mannes blod ageote, ne cume he na on ðæs cyniges neawæste, gyf he cyninges man sy, ær he on dædbote ga, swa biscop him tæce ⁊ his scrift him wisige.
Si quis sceleratis manibus effundat sanguinem Christianum, non appareat in conspectu regis, priusquam emendationem ineat, sicut episcopus docebit et penitentia consulat.
[Be monslihte.] [Ld] Gif hwa Cristenes mannes blód ageote, ne cume he na on ðæs cyninges neawiste, ær he on dædbote ga, swa him biscop tæce ⁊ his scrift him wisige.
Gif hwa Cristenes mannes blod ageote, ne cume he na on ðæs cyninges neawiste ær he on dædbote ga, swa him biscop tæce and his scrift him wisige.
If anyone sheds the blood of a Christian man, he shall not come anywhere near the king, until he proceeds to do penance, as the bishop appoints for him or his confessor directs him.
And if anyone sheds Christian blood, he may not come into the proximity of the king until he undertakes penance as the bishop instructs him and his confessor directs him.

(Über Todtschlag. Ld) Wenn jemand das Blut eines Christenmenschen vergiesst, komme er nicht in des Königs Nähe (Angesicht H Qu., wenn er des Königs Vasall ist B), bevor er Kirchenbusse antrete, wie ihm der Bischof vorschreibt und sein Beichtvater anweist.

(Of homicide. Ld) If anyone sheds the blood of a Christian man, let him not come into the king's presence (sight, H Qu.; if he is the king's man, B) before he undertakes penance, as the bishop prescribes for him and his confessor directs him.
